verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. List/Create/Fetch/Update/Delete Webhook pages) and a free Developer Sandbox. Requests can be run from the command line or through an official Postman Collection, so runnable examples exist but depend on an external tool rather than the reference itself. No public OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. Missing for 10: an in-browser interactive 'try it' console in the reference, documented runnable code samples on reference pages, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
